note: Equipment items. slot: weapon, head, body, hands, bottoms, feet, necklace, earrings, bracers or ring. A weapon's `class` (a class id) or an armor piece's `gear` (Heavy, Light or Household, combat-guide.md) and its `level` set what it needs (classes/stats.json requirements: base stats only); accessories need the level only. rarity: a stats.json rarity (brown, white, grey, lightBlue, darkBlue, lightOrange, darkOrange): the kind's own for training gear; a dropped item rolls its own (the kind's is a stand-in). bound: can't be traded. training: the Tanod's training gear (stats.json trainingGear): also never dropped, sold, enhanced or disassembled. agimats: the agimats set in it (none yet). stats: a training piece's own atk or def (everything else's base comes from classes/stats.json gearBase by its level; its rolls are the item's own), also hp, mp, str, dex, int, crit; `placeholder` lists the fields whose numbers are stand-ins (to fill in later). icon is 16x16 (rows, slots), showcase 32x32 (pop-ups, toasts), large 64x64; an item without them shows its slot's empty silhouette until its art is added. The Mid tier (Lv 30: Bronze, Linen, Bamboo, Fine, Amber; Lv 40: Iron, Denim, Rattan, Polished, Jade; repo addition 20 Oct 2026) has no art yet: no icon, showcase or large, so each shows its slot's silhouette.
